A variant of Circuit Value Problem over the basis of Peirce's arrow (NOR) is introduced, in which one of the inputs of every kth gate must be the (k - 1)th gate. The problem, which remains P-complete, is encoded as a simple formal language over a two-letter alphabet. It is shown that this language can be naturally and succinctly represented by language equations from several classes.
